column5: Stock MIT, copyright "MCP Brasil e contribuidores" 2025-2026
column6: YES — the code grant, unconditional on its own terms

column5: Declares the MIT licence covers EXCLUSIVELY the source code; names three exclusions: (1) DATA returned by third-party APIs, each source carrying its own terms; (2) MARKS/LOGOS/NAMES of Brazilian public institutions; (3) abusive or illegal use, deferring to ACCEPTABLE_USE.md for "vedacoes vinculantes" (binding prohibitions) derived from LGPD, electoral law and freedom-of-information law.  Also disclaims officiality: NOT a Brazilian government service.
column6: ASSERTS SO — "Mantenha este NOTICE, o LICENSE e a referencia a SOURCES.md"; "Respeite ACCEPTABLE_USE.md"

column5: Politica de Uso Aceitavel.  Section 2 "Vedacoes Especificas" prohibits named uses per domain: 2.1 health (LGPD art. 11 para 4), 2.2 electoral (Lei 9.504/97 + TSE resolutions), 2.3 judicial (CNJ Res. 446/2022), 2.4 disabling default PII masking without documented legal basis under LGPD art. 7 or 11 — the env var MCP_BRASIL_LGPD_ALLOW_PII exists for legitimate cases and activating it TRANSFERS CONTROLLER RESPONSIBILITY to the operator, 2.5 presenting AI-generated output as official data
Per-source licence and notice register across 61 headed sections covering ~70 Brazilian public APIs.  Section 4 is "Educacao — RISCO ALTO" and is the reason this row belongs on an EDUCATION shelf.
column6: YES — attribution obligations are per source, not per project

column1: # --- Section 4, Educacao, read first-hand: what an education engagement actually gets ---

column2: Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anisio Teixeira — ENEM microdata and the Censo Escolar (national school census), 2023 snapshot

INEP removed microdata from public access in 2022 under LGPD pressure and resumed publication in anonymised post-LGPD form in 2024; the project's 2023 snapshot is stated to be compatible with the post-LGPD resumption

the constant COLUNAS_DISTINCT_PERMITIDAS in datasets/inep_enem/constants.py whitelists only aggregate categories (UF, sex, age band, race, school) and does NOT expose PII columns (NU_INSCRICAO, name, CPF)
re-identification of individuals by cross-referencing other bases is VEDADO (LGPD art. 12, sole paragraph).  Attribution: INEP

column1: escalation path named by the project
column2: formal research on non-anonymised microdata (e.g. longitudinal tracking per candidate) must use INEP's SEDAP protected-data access service — explicitly out of scope for this server

the project's own open item is to validate one sample of the 2023 ZIP and list every CSV column to confirm absence of direct re-identification keys.  It is published as an open item, not as a clearance
